title: Corsair CV550 550 Watt 80 Plus Bronze Certified Non-Modular ATX Power Supply

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Corsair CV550 550W Power Supply is a dependable and efficient PSU designed for entry-level gaming PCs, office systems, and home builds. Certified with 80 Plus Bronze efficiency, it ensures lower power consumption and reduced heat generation, delivering stable performance for everyday computing.


Built with a 120mm thermally controlled fan, the CV550 operates quietly while maintaining optimal cooling. Its non-modular cable design keeps installation simple, while high-quality components provide consistent voltage output and long-term durability.


Ideal for budget-friendly PC builds in Bangladesh, the Corsair CV550 offers trusted performance and essential protection features for safe and reliable system operation.


Key Features


  • 550 Watt continuous power output
  • 80 Plus Bronze certified efficiency
  • Non-modular cable design
  • 120mm cooling fan for quiet operation
  • Stable and reliable power delivery
  • Compact ATX form factor
  • Designed for home and office PC builds
